title: Page 253
transc:
McCaine  Washington Dec 20 1864
Clotilda Nelson Vegus tulip I
send out a sprague pedlar
wherry on the route indicated
in your despatch of last
evening yacht I am just
off for your place lantern


Beckwith  Washn Decr 20th 1864
Florence Oliver Bellows tulip I hope Ewell
use every exertion togget ussa Harvey paper
as we shall hear first through that
source concerning the joint Ripley Fox Benjamin


#1
JW Sampson Balto  Washn Decr 20th 1864 
Jennie harrow for Dr Wm C Van Bibber
Baptism I have concluded to release Mrs Hutchins
on the terms that I mentioned and will
forward the order to you blithe first train
EM Stanton 
Secy of War
